body: Surfaced refining DASH-54/55: they were added without 'source' (older board.py / out-of-band), the newer validate_item requires it, and 'edit' has no --source flag, so the only repair was an out-of-band backfill + mutate_roadmap re-stamp. Fix: add --source to the edit verb (one-liner) and/or have 'add' refuse to omit it. Also: milestone-add (mutate_roadmap) leaves milestone.items=[] until a mutate_items verb syncs membership — a fresh milestone with pre-versioned items renders invalid until then.
title: board.py: 'edit' verb can't set 'source'; items added out-of-band (older/hand) lack required field and are CLI-unrepairable
